name: shinchantw_cbt_payment_after_boss_section_3d_20260731_192401_531001
sql:
/*
7/29 创角 cohort，观察窗 7/29~7/31：
每笔有效充值归因到此前最后挑战的主线 Boss（章-小节-5），汇总小节付费数据。
*/
WITH UserBlacklist AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id FROM user_result_cluster_18
    WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users', 'is_windows', 'is_water')
), CohortUsers AS (
    SELECT v."#account_id" AS account_id, MIN(v."#event_time") AS role_time
    FROM ta.v_event_18 v LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist b ON v."#user_id" = b.user_id
    WHERE v."$part_event" = 'new_role' AND v."$part_date" = '2026-07-29'
      AND v."#account_id" IS NOT NULL AND b.user_id IS NULL GROUP BY 1
), StageMap AS (
    SELECT TRY_CAST("stage_id@stage_id" AS BIGINT) AS stage_id, MAX("stage_id@stage_name_real") AS stage_name_real
    FROM ta_dim.dim_18_0_52765 GROUP BY 1
), BossFights AS (
    SELECT c.account_id, v."#event_time" AS fight_time,
           CONCAT(SPLIT(m.stage_name_real, '-')[1], '-', SPLIT(m.stage_name_real, '-')[2]) AS section_key
    FROM ta.v_event_18 v INNER JOIN CohortUsers c ON v."#account_id" = c.account_id
    LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist b ON v."#user_id" = b.user_id
    INNER JOIN StageMap m ON m.stage_id = COALESCE(TRY_CAST(v.a_rst[1].id AS BIGINT), TRY_CAST(v.stage_id AS BIGINT))
    WHERE v."#event_name" = 'stage_fight' AND TRY_CAST(v.a_rst[1].key AS INTEGER) = 1001
      AND v."$part_date" BETWEEN '2026-07-29' AND '2026-07-31' AND b.user_id IS NULL
      AND CARDINALITY(SPLIT(m.stage_name_real, '-')) = 3 AND SPLIT(m.stage_name_real, '-')[3] = '5'
), ValidCharges AS (
    SELECT c.account_id, v."#event_time" AS charge_time,
           CAST(v.pay_amount AS DOUBLE) / COALESCE(x.exchange, 1) AS revenue_usd
    FROM ta.v_event_18 v INNER JOIN CohortUsers c ON v."#account_id" = c.account_id
    LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist b ON v."#user_id" = b.user_id
    LEFT JOIN ta_dim.ta_exchange x ON v."$part_date" = x.ex_date AND v.pay_currency = x.currency
    WHERE v."$part_event" = 'charge' AND v."$part_date" BETWEEN '2026-07-29' AND '2026-07-31'
      AND v."#event_time" >= c.role_time AND b.user_id IS NULL
      AND (v.sandbox IS NULL OR v.sandbox = FALSE) AND (v.is_freebuy IS NULL OR v.is_freebuy = FALSE)
), ChargeAttribution AS (
    SELECT account_id, section_key, revenue_usd FROM (
        SELECT ch.account_id, b.section_key, ch.revenue_usd,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ch.account_id, ch.charge_time ORDER BY b.fight_time DESC) AS rn
        FROM ValidCharges ch INNER JOIN BossFights b ON b.account_id = ch.account_id AND b.fight_time < ch.charge_time
    ) t WHERE rn = 1
), BossReached AS (
    SELECT section_key, COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) AS boss_users FROM BossFights GROUP BY 1
), PaymentStats AS (
    SELECT section_key, COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) AS pay_users, COUNT(*) AS payment_orders,
           SUM(revenue_usd) AS revenue_usd
    FROM ChargeAttribution GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT b.section_key AS "充值前最后Boss小节", b.boss_users AS "挑战该Boss人数",
       COALESCE(p.pay_users, 0) AS "付费人数", COALESCE(p.payment_orders, 0) AS "付费笔数",
       ROUND(COALESCE(p.revenue_usd, 0), 2) AS "付费金额(USD)",
       ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(p.pay_users, 0) / NULLIF(b.boss_users, 0), 2) AS "付费率(%)"
FROM BossReached b LEFT JOIN PaymentStats p ON b.section_key = p.section_key
ORDER BY "付费金额(USD)" DESC, "付费人数" DESC, "充值前最后Boss小节";
